directives: Write in first person with a builder's voice grounded in shipped work.
Explain why each change matters, not only what changed.
Use a hook, introduction, body, and conclusion with short paragraphs.
Name internal systems only after translating their purpose for the reader.
exemplars: I built the first useful version, then found the failure path that made it unreliable. This pass is about the part readers do not see: the evidence that tells us when the system should refuse to pretend it succeeded.
